== Biography ==
Ellam started his career streaming on Twitch, and got a lot of attention from other Turkish streamers because of his high rank and play-style. He streamed for a while before deciding to play professionally in the [[TCL]], spending his first split with [[Bursaspor Esports]] before moving on to join [[1907 Fenerbahçe Esports]].

== Trivia ==
* Is a dual citizen of Sweden and Turkey.
* Known for his {{ci|Yasuo}}.
* Was a streamer before he decided to go pro.
* Has a black belt in karate.
* Started playing League of Legends because of his older cousin.
